product.name: clAIrity
product.tagline: A friendly media scan for everyday people.
product.audience: General consumers, including families, kids, and older adults.
product.primaryFlow: Scan a webpage or social post

summary.headline: Scan media before you trust it
summary.intro: clAIrity checks pictures, videos, audio, and text for signs that AI may have created or changed them. Results are written in plain language and show what to do next.
summary.currentExplanation: The post has a few visual and source clues that deserve a second look, but there is not enough evidence to call it AI-made.

scanSamples.label: Shared news image
scanSamples.finding: No trusted source attached; background texture looks softened.
scanSamples.nextStep: Look for the original post or a trusted news source.

scanSamples.label: Short video clip
scanSamples.finding: The clip has consistent lighting and no obvious edit boundary.
scanSamples.nextStep: Check the page date and author before sharing.

scanSamples.label: Voice message
scanSamples.finding: Voice rhythm and background noise change suddenly mid-sentence.
scanSamples.nextStep: Confirm with the person through another channel.

scanSamples.label: Viral text post
scanSamples.finding: The post uses urgent sharing language and does not name a source.
scanSamples.nextStep: Look for a dated source from a trusted outlet before sharing.

extensionMoments.title: Popup scan result
extensionMoments.detail: A 15-second read with a large score, the top evidence clue, and a safer sharing action.

extensionMoments.title: Right-click page scan
extensionMoments.detail: Turns a selected post or webpage into a focused scan without making users upload files.

extensionMoments.title: On-page warning overlay
extensionMoments.detail: A gentle warning appears near suspicious media, with a link to the full explanation.

extensionMoments.title: History and privacy controls
extensionMoments.detail: Saved scan summaries and family privacy settings stay separate from the active scan flow.

provenance.refreshMode: Manual refresh can replace sample scan rows while preserving the template.
provenance.notes: Sample data is synthetic and preview-oriented; no user media or private auth material is stored.
